Differential Diagnoses
- Scabies
- Pediculosis
- Papular urticaria
- Papulo necrotic tuberculids
- Pruritic papular eruption of HIV
- Other causes of generalized pruritus without a rash
- Other causes of subcutaneous nodules e.g.
- Sparganosis
- Paragonimiasis
- Gnathostomiasis
- Cysticercosis
- Echinococcosis
